say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.scene.salt_1: A touch more salt, I think.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.scene.roast_1: There's roast on the spit, it's the rest day!
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.scene.roast_2: Roast on the spit today, folks!
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.verdict.over_: Hm. One flavour is rather loud.
I'd say there's too much of one thing in it.
Nearly there, but there's too much of one thing.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.verdict.under: It's light on one thing, I'd say.
Nearly there. It wants a bit more of one thing.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.verdict.right: Now that is how it's done.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.verdict.far_1: It's food. I'll give it that.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.verdict.far_2: I've tasted better, and I've tasted worse.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.tier.hallmark: I'll be telling people about this one.
That is as good as it gets.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.first_0: That's new from you. Here's a little extra.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.first_1: Something new from you! A little extra for it.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.first_2: First of those from you. Here's a little extra.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.full_0: We've plenty of that already today.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.full_1: I couldn't sell another portion of that today.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.full_2: The larder's full of that one, I'm afraid.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.stale_0: That's past its best, so I'll pay less.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.stale_1: It's not as fresh as it was. I'll pay less.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.gone_1: I can't take that. It's turned.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.baker.no_0: That's not for me. Try the innkeeper.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.baker.no_1: I only take baked goods here.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.baker.no_2: Take that along to the innkeeper.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.busy_2: Hold on, I'm in the middle of something.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.guest.no_0: The back pot's for those I know.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.guest.no_1: I don't know you well enough for the back pot.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.guest.yes_0: The back pot is yours when you want it.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.guest.yes_1: You've earned the use of the back pot.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.guest.yes_2: The back pot's yours to use.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.alms.fine_0: What a lovely thing to give. Bless you.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.alms.fine_1: A dish like that for the poor? Bless you.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.slate_0: The slate's chalked with what we want today.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.slate_1: We're after a few dishes today. It's on the slate.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.slate_2: Have a look at the slate. We're after a few dishes.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.request_0: There's a special order on the slate today.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.request_1: I've a request on the slate, if you're a cook.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.request_2: Someone wants several portions of one dish. See the slate.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.none_1: Nothing on the slate for you today.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.backdoor_0: Hold it out to me and I'll taste it.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.backdoor_1: Bring me what you've cooked and I'll make you an offer.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.backdoor_2: Show me your cooking and I'll tell you what it's worth.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.purveyor_0: Folk are asking after your cooking.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.purveyor_1: Your name's the talk of the kitchen.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.season.winter: It's a broth sort of winter.
Winter wants something hot in the belly.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.season.autumn: The harvest is coming in, and folk want feeding.
Autumn's the season for a hearty dish.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.palate.temper: Pies and tarts: that's what this town likes.
A good pie never goes begging in this town.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.palate.northe: Stew and smoked strips: that's what this town likes.
A good stew never goes begging in this town.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.palate.desert: Glazed roots and trail loaves: that's what this town likes.
A good loaf never goes begging in this town.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.palate.savann: Roast and honey cakes: that's what this town likes.
A good roast never goes begging in this town.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.relished_0: That dish of yours, I'm still thinking about it.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.relished_1: What you cooked this week, I haven't stopped talking about it.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.relished_2: You can cook, I'll say that. It was a good meal.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.fedwell_0: Best meal I've had in a good while.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.fedwell_2: It's been a good week for eating.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.chilled_0: You look frozen through. Get something hot inside you.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.chilled_1: You're blue with cold. Go and find a hot bowl.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.chilled_2: Cold out here. Get something hot to eat.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.told.hallmark: They say someone cooked something wonderful lately.
There's talk of a dish folk are still raving about.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.told.cookoff_: Did you hear who won the Harvest Table?
The Harvest Table has been won, you know.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.told.burnt_0: Someone burnt a whole pot at the tavern.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.told.burnt_1: A whole pot ruined at the tavern. What a waste.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.pot.smells_2: Whatever that is, it smells good.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.pot.hallmark_: Is that a hallmark? Look at that!
That's a master's work, that is.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.judge.open_0: Bring your dishes to the table!
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.judge.open_1: The Harvest Table is open to every cook!
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.judge.win_0: And the Harvest Table goes to...
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.judge.win_1: The cook of this year's Harvest Table is...
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.shop.cry_1: Dishes for sale, come and get them!
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.shop.cry_2: Food for sale here, food for sale!
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.shop.first_0: The first plate from the new shop!
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.shop.first_1: Our very first plate, and welcome to it!
say.guildmark.talk.works.raised.cookshop: There's a new cookshop in the square. Have you smelled it?
A cookshop in the market now, and the smell of it!
say.guildmark.talk.works.also.raised.coo: And there's the cookshop in the square.
There's a cookshop gone up in the market, too.
